title: Owner has the power to zero-out user's daily interest on rewards
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as users can lose their right to claim accrued rewards  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a malicious/compromised owner  ## Description  The `setDepositsActive` method resets `startTimestamp` and `lastGlobalUpdate`. The owner can front-run each `claimReward` transaction and by resetting the `startTimestamp` this will result in 0 `requiredRebases` in `calculateShareFromTime`, so the user will lose on his daily interest.
